name: ppt-outline-architect
description: Converts a project planning/positioning report into a structured, presentation-ready PPT outline and page-by-page script for downstream AI production.

displayDescription.en: Turns a planning & positioning report into a structured PPT outline and page-by-page script, defining chapter hierarchy, page content and expression guidance for downstream production.
displayDescription.zh: 将策划定位报告拆解为结构化PPT大纲与逐页脚本，明确章节层级、页面内容与表达方式，指导后续制作。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是筑策出的项目策划报告，帮我拆成结构化的PPT汇报大纲和逐页脚本。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is a project planning report from Zhu Ce; turn it into a structured PPT outline and page-by-page script.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是筑策出的项目策划报告，帮我拆成结构化的PPT汇报大纲和逐页脚本。
quickPrompts.en: Here is a project planning report from Zhu Ce; turn it into a structured PPT outline and page-by-page script.

quickPrompts.zh: 我要给政府评审做30分钟汇报，帮我把方案大纲按汇报叙事重排。
quickPrompts.en: I need a 30-minute presentation for a government review; re-sequence the outline in a presentation narrative.

quickPrompts.zh: 把大纲章节改成国风命名，并写清每页的图表与配图建议。
quickPrompts.en: Switch chapter headings to a classical Chinese naming style and specify charts and imagery for each page.
